title: Katz Kernel Based Stratification of Breast Cancer Patients
abstract: arXiv:2611.14540v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The integration of mechanistic signaling networks into clinical research has become a cornerstone of precision oncology. By capturing the complex biochemical interactions within a cell, these networks provide a functional map of disease progression that goes beyond simple genomic mutations. Consequently, the development of specific signaling models of patients has significant relevance, allowing for a more granular representation of individual disease profiles. In this setting, there is a growing need for robust methodologies capable of comparing graph based pathway structures to identify similarities and differences across patient cohorts. Such comparisons are essential for the identification of clinically meaningful subgroups, and the discovery of novel biomarkers. translated_title: 基于Katz核的乳腺癌患者分层方法
translated_abstract: 将机制性信号网络整合到临床研究中已成为精准肿瘤学的基石。通过捕捉细胞内复杂的生化相互作用，这些网络提供了一个超越简单基因组突变的功能性疾病进展图谱。因此，开发患者特异性信号模型具有重要意义，能够更精细地表示个体疾病谱。在这种背景下，人们日益需要稳健的方法来比较基于图的通路结构，以识别患者队列之间的异同。这种比较对于识别具有临床意义的亚群和发现新型生物标志物至关重要。标准的图核方法虽然在数学上严谨，但往往过于通用而难以实现这一目的，它们经常无法捕捉基因信号传导所特有的特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Katz核的图核方法，通过比较患者特异性的信号通路网络结构来实现乳腺癌患者分层，从而识别具有临床意义的患者亚群并助力新型生物标志物的发现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Katz kernel-based graph kernel method for stratifying breast cancer patients by comparing patient-specific signaling pathway network structures, enabling the identification of clinically meaningful subgroups and the discovery of novel biomarkers.
